summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the English translation of a notice to the Tokyo Stock Exchange regarding the determination of the disposal price for treasury stock issued under its employee share-based compensation plan. The disposal price was set at 2,983.5 yen per share, totaling 3,444,152,400 yen, based on the higher of two reference closing prices. This is a routine administrative step in an employee compensation plan, not a special situation. There is no premium, no tender offer, and no strategic event. The filing simply follows standard corporate practice for share-based compensation. What to watch: no market-moving events expected.
